players.label: RB depth
players.reason: Dylan Sampson is the first RB depth claim to consider. Preserve Lloyd’s Jacobs insurance; do not cut a scarce RB simply to force this pickup.

players.label: WR upside
players.reason: Antonio Williams is a role-growth target if a trade creates space. Prefer him to adding another defense.

rosterMove: Keep Chiefs and McPherson. Jets are the first cut, but activating Hall from IR may use that opening. Chiefs and Addison are already in pending offers.
